result.reason: The file conforms to every criterion in the Service Conventions specification. Structure: it exports a single runtime entry point, `run(store, input)`, with the Store first and a single input object, returning `Result<RankedParlor[]>` from the domain types; the module name `rank-parlors.ts` is verb-first kebab-case. Behavior: domain failures are returned as `{ ok: false, error }` values with no throws; the error message names the field and what would be accepted ('minReviews must be a whole number of 0 or more'); validation runs top-to-bottom before any work; the service does one thing; and all I/O goes through the injected Store (listParlors/listReviews) with no timers, fetch, or console. Documentation: the doc comment states the purpose in one sentence and enumerates the domain failure modes (minReviews negative or not a whole number), matching the actual validation so callers can handle every error without reading the body.
